name: oak-memory
description: Persistent personal and shared vector+graph memory through local or cloud profiles.

profiles_file.title: Memory profiles file
profiles_file.description: Absolute path to the nonsecret profiles.json downloaded from the Memory dashboard. Leave empty to preserve existing local configuration.

default_profile.title: Starting memory profile
default_profile.description: Optional profile name for new sessions. Leave empty to use the profiles file default. Switching inside a session does not change this value.

cloud_credentials.title: Personal graph keys (secure)
cloud_credentials.description: JSON object mapping each profile credentialEnv reference to its matching personal graph-bound key. Enter only here after approving access; never paste keys into chat or profile downloads. Stored in Claude secure storage. Leave empty for local mode or injected environment credentials.
